title: Positive: all required quality gates pass and the schema enforces integrity
steps: backend: tsc --noEmit; jest --runInBand; npm run test:db. frontend: npm run lint; tsc --noEmit; vitest --run; NODE_ENV=production npm run build; npm run check:css.
actual: Backend typecheck clean; 661/661 unit tests (84 suites); 212/212 DB-backed tests (24 suites). Frontend lint 0 errors (3 warnings); typecheck clean; Vitest 478/478 on re-run (see F-053); production build and check:css pass. Database: all 92 tables have primary keys, 155 foreign keys, 92 check constraints, no money stored as floating point; the 8 ID columns without foreign keys are mostly polymorphic by design.
impact: Strong base for the fixes in this report.
